tagline: Find the gap. Fix the gap. Prove the recovery.
context: Education Web Application (Data Structures Recovery Platform)
design_theme: Calm, high-contrast education workspace with warm paper surfaces and crisp blue/emerald progress states

typography.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900

top_bar.demo_mode_controls: Reset Demo State button with instant notification toast

acceptance_journey_flow: 1. Diagnostic Assessment: Student answers 30-item realistic question bank on Data Structures (Arrays -> Linked List -> Stack -> Queue).
2. Repeated FIFO/LIFO Error Detection: System logs per-question evidence & detects confusion between Stack (LIFO) vs Queue (FIFO).
3. Root Gap Diagnosis: Debugger identifies LIFO fundamental node stack pointer concept as the exact root gap.
4. Why Am I Stuck Evidence: Presents concrete attempt history, prerequisite graph links, and misconception tags.
5. LIFO Intervention Engine: Selects targeted interactive tutorial + visual animation on Push/Pop stack operation.
6. Targeted Practice: 3 focused questions specifically testing LIFO state transition.
7. Retest & Recovery Threshold: Evaluates post-practice score against >=80% threshold.
8. Path Unlocked: Marks LIFO recovered, unlocks dependent Stack concepts, updates Dashboard & Teacher Radar.
9. Demo Reset: Allows immediate replay of the full acceptance loop.

QuestionCard.style: Warm paper card with clear question prompt, code snippet box (JetBrains Mono background #0F172A), radio selection options, data-testid='question-card'

EvidenceDrawer.style: Side panel with amber/rose header, listing repeated misconceptions, prerequisite gap tree, and confidence scores, data-testid='evidence-drawer'

RecoveryCenter.style: High-contrast emerald/slate panel showcasing before/after mastery gauge, targeted 3-question practice widget, and retest trigger, data-testid='recovery-center'

PrerequisiteGraph.style: Interactive visual tree displaying node progression: Arrays -> Linked List (Node, Traversal, Insertion) -> LIFO (Stack: Push/Pop) -> FIFO (Queue: Enqueue/Dequeue)

TeacherRadar.style: Classroom grid dashboard showing student cohort gaps, average recovery time, intervention effectiveness matrix, and flagged students

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements (buttons, nav tabs, radio options, reset triggers, practice cards) MUST have data-testid in kebab-case format.
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_wcag: All body text meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 on warm paper (#FAF8F5 / #FFFFFF). Buttons explicitly define text color on hover state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Maintain high-contrast warm paper design aesthetic using #FAF8F5 background, #FFFFFF cards, and 1px crisp borders.
Do NOT use purple gradients or generic dark AI assistant templates.
Implement full end-to-end working state for Demo Student in React + FastAPI + MongoDB.
Ensure every state transition in the acceptance journey is functional and reflected across Assessment, Why Am I Stuck, Recovery Center, Prerequisite Graph, Student Dashboard, and Teacher Radar.
Ensure all mock RAG and AI components have clear PROTOTYPE badges for architectural clarity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling. Use warm paper surfaces with asymmetric bento cards.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons; use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Add explicit hover, focus, and active micro-interactions to all interactive elements.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes for automated test validation.
Ensure header and overlays never use pure transparent backgrounds; use backdrop-blur or solid warm background.
